original_test_intent: Run the intended topology-sized miniHPL workload and prove every scheduled test executed and passed with the documented success code, acceptable numerical residual, no timeout/skip/failure and no new GPU or system health anomaly.
original_method: Bind AGFHC/miniHPL and GPU topology to approved N, NB, PxQ, iterations, timeout and residual thresholds; preserve baseline GPU/RAS/system state, start independent monitoring and run once on a dedicated SUT; retain complete stdout/stderr, actual generated log directory and result.json, reconcile executed/skipped/elapsed/return status and residual evidence, then compare post-health without clearing logs.
manual_activity: The owner approves miniHPL recipe/parameters and resolves success/residual/timeout semantics; an operator monitors the numerical stress and captures actual artifacts; the owner reviews complete numerical/system evidence and decides the verdict.
required_inputs: Exact N, NB, PxQ, iteration and blocking configuration
Correct success code and failure/status-code mapping
Residual/error tolerance, skip and timeout acceptance
Dedicated maintenance, GPU/thermal/power/RAS aborts, storage and recovery
safety_requirements: Require approval for exact topology-sized workload and no competing GPU load
Use protected access and preserve full output plus all generated files
Do not change N/NB/PxQ/blocking during a run
Start/verify independent GPU/thermal/power/RAS monitoring before stress
Use timestamped baseline/post logs rather than clearing them
Stop on numerical/residual failure, timeout, skip, error, RAS delta, GPU loss or limit
Do not rerun with changed parameters after unexplained failure
agent_execution_scope: Collect topology/tool/recipe identity, criteria and health baselines
Validate exact parameters, storage and generated-artifact paths
After approval run one miniHPL workload with monitoring
Parse summary, return code, result.json, residual, skips/timeouts and post-health
Perform no parameter/threshold correction by guess, recovery or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve success-code typo and approve recipe/parameters/residual/timeout/skip rules
Authorize/monitor numerical stress and recovery thresholds
Disposition numerical or system anomalies and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED
